$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

panelMinTesters.description: Fewest testers a playtest needs for its indicators to mean something (FR68).

relaunchMinPct.description: Indicator 1: share of testers (in %) who start another game without being asked.

perfectCitedMinPct.description: Indicator 2: share of testers (in %) who spontaneously cite the perfect parry as a high point.

identifiedMinPct.description: Indicator 3 (observed): share of testers (in %) who identify the right response to a threat at its first encounter, without help. Applies to each threat.

firstEncounterSuccessMinPct.description: Indicator 3 (computed proxy): share of testers (in %) whose first resolved response to a threat is a success or a perfect. Applies to each threat.

touchVsKeyboardMinPct.description: Indicator 4: success rate on touch, as a share (in %) of the success rate on the keyboard.

laughedMinPct.description: Indicator 5: share of testers (in %) who laugh at least once during a level.

items.description: One activity of Papa a tester is asked to name.

activities.description: Indicator 6 (observed): Papa's activities the testers are asked to name, the `activityId` of Geo's notes.

namedMinPct.description: Indicator 6 (observed): share of the testers with a note (in %) who name what Papa does, without his bubble. Applies to each activity.

repetitivePoseMaxTesters.description: Indicator 6 (observed): most testers who may spontaneously find one of his poses repetitive.

bodyRead.description: Indicator 6, « Papa se lit sans sa bulle » (story 7.12).

maxStarGap.description: The bot's mean stars must stay within this many stars of the testers' median (strictly under).

maxPerfectExcessPct.description: How many points of perfect rate (in %) the bot may have above the testers' median rate.

humanBot.description: The thresholds of the human-bot comparison (`npm run sim -- --compare`).

runs.description: Games per bot (the GDD says 200 seeds): run i uses seed + i.

seed.description: The seed of the first game.

tier.description: The difficulty tier the games are played at (the GDD says Normal).

min.description: Fewest games the `human` bot may lose, in % (inclusive).

max.description: Most games the `human` bot may lose, in % (inclusive).

humanLossPct.description: The share of games, in %, the `human` bot loses (Mama came home early: `endsByReason.mamaHome`): a loss is possible without being a wall.

humanMustFailDefs.description: Threat defs the `human` bot must fail at least once over the games (a threat nobody can fail is not a threat): the big room’s new mischiefs. A def the games never met counts as not failed.

humanOpenDoorMustGag.description: True: over the games the baby gets into the open dishwasher at least once (`chores.open.gagged` above 0) with the `human` bot.

perfectChoresEveryRun.description: True: the `perfect` bot finishes every house chore of the level in every game.

idleLosesBeforeTimer.description: True: the `idle` bot loses every game, before the level’s timer runs out.

simulated.description: The simulated-games targets of the first level (`npm run sim:balance`, part of `npm run ci`).
